local KA = U([[0?0V0E030^190:]])
local KB = U([[0v090c0W0{0O19]])
local SS = U([[0P0O0Y0Y161P2;1p1f1h]])
local Rtab = {}

    Rtab[O[i] + 1] = U(P[i])
end
local flat = {}
for i = 1, #Rtab do
    for j = 1, #Rtab[i] do
        flat[#flat + 1] = Rtab[i][j]
    end
end
local real = {}
for i = 2, #flat, 3 do
    real[#real + 1] = flat[i]
end
for i = 1, #real do
    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = ((math.floor(v / 8)) + ((v * 32) % 256)) % 256
end
for i = 1, #real - 1, 2 do
    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = real[i + 1]
    real[i + 1] = v
end
for i = 1, #real do
    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = ((v % 16) * 16) + math.floor(v / 16)
end
local d = {}
for i = 1, #real do
    local v = real[i]
    for j = #KB, 1, -1 do
        v = (v - KB[j]) % 256
        if v < 0 then v = v + 256 end
    end
    for j = #KA, 1, -1 do
        v = (v - KA[j]) % 256
        if v < 0 then v = v + 256 end
    end
    d[i] = v
end
local function X(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        if a % 2 ~= b % 2 then r = r + p end
        a = math.floor(a / 2)
        b = math.floor(b / 2)
        p = p * 2
    end
    return r
end
local function apply(data, s, t)
    local ks = s
    local s2 = {}
    for i = 1, #data do
        s2[i] = X(X(data[i], ks % 256), (i * 19 + 13) % 256)
        ks = (ks + t) % 256
    end
    return s2
end

    M[string.sub(A, i, i)] = i - 1
end
local function U(s)
    local o = {}
    local i = 1
    while i <= #s do
        o[#o + 1] = (M[string.sub(s, i, i)] or 0) * 85 + (M[string.sub(s, i + 1, i + 1)] or 0)
        i = i + 2
    end
    return o

    Rtab[O[i] + 1] = U(P[i])
end
local flat = {}
for i = 1, #Rtab do
    for j = 1, #Rtab[i] do
        flat[#flat + 1] = Rtab[i][j]
    end
end
local real = {}
for i = 2, #flat, 3 do
    real[#real + 1] = flat[i]
end

    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = ((math.floor(v / 8)) + ((v * 32) % 256)) % 256
end

    local v = real[i]
    real[i] = real[i + 1]
    real[i + 1] = v

local d = {}
for i = 1, #real do
    local v = real[i]
    for j = #KB, 1, -1 do
        v = (v - KB[j]) % 256
        if v < 0 then v = v + 256 end
    end
    for j = #KA, 1, -1 do
        v = (v - KA[j]) % 256
        if v < 0 then v = v + 256 end
    end
    d[i] = v
end
local function X(a, b)
    local r, p = 0, 1
    while a > 0 or b > 0 do
        if a % 2 ~= b % 2 then r = r + p end
        a = math.floor(a / 2)
        b = math.floor(b / 2)
        p = p * 2
    end
    return r
end
local function apply(data, s, t)
    local ks = s
    local s2 = {}
    for i = 1, #data do
        s2[i] = X(X(data[i], ks % 256), (i * 19 + 13) % 256)
        ks = (ks + t) % 256
    end
    return s2
end
